request-prompt: Position the 'Sponsored Content' grid directly underneath the main video player instead of burying it at the very bottom of the page so I can easily find recommended external links.
goal: I am highly tolerant of sponsored content and frequently click on recommended articles from around the web to find quirky stories or products.
jobs: I want to watch the video about weird exoplanets to learn about NASA's recent space discoveries
I want to share this space science video with friends or family who are interested in astronomy
I want to look up the local weather forecast or radar for a specific location using the search bar
I want to browse other trending weather videos and news categories to stay informed on recent events
I want to read seasonal home and garden advice, such as guides on termite season, to protect my property

preference-pairs.a: I prefer watching short-form videos to learn about science and news topics because I find them more engaging and digestible than long-form articles.
